# skycloak_cluster_upgrade_path (Data Source)

Recommended version-upgrade path for a cluster, ordered from current to target.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_cluster_upgrade_path" "production" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
}
```

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.
